subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add dedicated generic reaction add/remove hooks for Discord now, or fold this request into a broader inbound non-message event Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: Source proves the missing behavior, but the permanent hook names, payload shape, enrichment model, and cross-channel scope change the public plugin contract and need maintainer API intent.

options.title: Approve Generic Reaction Hooks
options.body: Add observation-only reaction_added and reaction_removed hooks with a shared payload, wire Discord first, and document how other channels should converge.

options.title: Fold Into Inbound Event Contract
options.body: Use the broader external-channel event work as the canonical API direction and keep this issue as a Discord-specific acceptance case for that design.

options.title: Defer Hook Surface
options.body: Keep reactions visible only as routed system events until maintainers sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Reaction Hooks
recommendation.body: Add observation-only reaction_added and reaction_removed hooks with a shared payload, wire Discord first, and document how other channels should converge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the public Plugin SDK hook contract, and git history ties vincentkoc most directly to the central hook contract files.
